This is one of the main reasons why many of our products have been developed in close collaboration with professional users in emergency response, rescue, and safety.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
4. QUALITY EDUCATION
We will make it possible for our employees to develop their own competence in what we produce and the products we deliver to our customers, as well as make it possible for our employees to develop and increase their general competence.
8. DECENT WORK AND ECONOMIC GROWTH
We challenge and facilitate that our employees are given work tasks that suit and challenge their competence. As a company, we will continue to grow and be financially sustainable to create a safe workplace for our employees, and we will be a sustainable supplier for our customers for many years.
9. INDUSTRIES, INNOVATION AND INFRASTRUCTURE
We will facilitate that our employees can take part in the daily operations to create innovative products and services that we can offer our customers as a supplier. We want to be a driving force for a sustainable restructuring of the business community where we with an efficient use of resources and environmentally friendly technology and production contribute to making the business community more sustainable. With a high proportion of our own production and inventory at Skoppum, we can deliver directly from us to the end customer, and thus reduce the climate footprint.
12. RESPONSIBLE CONSUMPTION AND PRODUCTION
We focus on ensuring that our materials can be recycled and reused. We strive to offer products where the largest possible proportion of materials used during production can be recycled, and we offer our customers a program where they can return the item to us for recycling and / or reuse. We set clear and unambiguous goals to reduce the amount of waste before, during and after production, and we strive to be a driving force for sustainable schemes for public procurement.
17. PARTNERSHIPS
We at Ferno Norden know that we cannot achieve the sustainability goals alone, but if we - with our employees, partners, customers and suppliers work together to achieve the goals, we will contribute what we can. By setting clear and distinct requirements for our partners, customers and suppliers, while at the same time placing the spotlight on what we can do to contribute to achieving the goals, we do what we can.
pages.title: About us | Ferno Norden

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Contact our sales offices
With dedicated teams and offices across several European countries, Ferno Norden is committed to meeting the safety, rescue, and emergency needs of the Nordic and Baltic regions. 
Ferno Norden owns and operates its sales offices in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and Finland, while trusted local sales teams represent us in the other countries such as Iceland, Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia, ensuring consistent expertise and support tailored to each region. For customers in the Faroe Islands and Greenland, sales and support are handled through our Danish office.
Whether you need product information, assistance with an order, or guidance on selecting the right solutions for your organization, our teams are ready to help. Contact your local office to find the best tools and systems to support your mission.
pages.title: Contact | Ferno Norden

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Confidence through visibility
By combining real-time system information with intuitive controls, Ferno Connect allows operators to see exactly what the system is doing at all times. Battery status, system feedback, and guided actions help ensure that each operation is carried out with confidence and control.
In addition to supporting daily use, Ferno Connect provides system insight through usage tracking and data. This helps EMS organisations better understand how equipment is used and supports more informed planning over time.
We invite you to contact us for a personal demonstration and discover how the Power X2 and Power F2 can transform your daily operations.
pages.title: Ferno Connect: Giving EMS full visibility and real-time control |…

pages.main_text_excerpt:
A system shaped by those who use it
The development of Power X2 and Power F2 reflects a broader shift in EMS — where equipment is not only designed for the field, but with direct input from it. With this in mind, focusing on durability and stability, we are seeing a predictable performance throughout daily use.
By incorporating real-world feedback into system design, the result is a solution that is better aligned with the demands of modern EMS operations — supporting safer, more consistent, and more efficient patient transport.
We invite you to contact us for a personal demonstration and discover how the Power X2 and Power F2 can transform your daily operations.
pages.title: How EMS feedback shaped Power X2 and Power F2 | Ferno Norden

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Beyond powered movement
For many years, powered loading and lifting have been standard expectations within modern EMS systems. Increasingly, however, attention is shifting toward how well these systems perform under real operational demands.
Visitors exploring the Power X2 and Power F2 system showed particular interest in areas linked to stability, ergonomics, manoeuvrability, and integrated workflow control — especially in situations where consistency and operator confidence are critical.
This aligns closely with independent testing previously conducted on Power X2, where the system demonstrated measurable advantages in several operational areas compared with another leading powered stretcher system.
pages.title: Power X2 and Power F2 draw strong interest at RETTmobil 2026 | Ferno…

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Regular maintenance means less downtime
For EMS organisations, unplanned equipment downtime can quickly affect operations.
A stretcher taken out of service may impact vehicle availability, increase workload on other units, or force crews to rely on backup solutions.
Scheduled checks, updates, and adjustments ensure that powered systems continue to operate as intended, reducing the risk of failures during critical moments.
pages.title: Service and maintenance - critical for powered stretchers | Ferno…

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Ferno Power X2 Ambulance Stretcher
The Ferno Power X2 Ambulance Stretcher sets a new standard in the industry with its cross-compatibility, enhanced power, improved visibility, and superior maneuverability—outperforming today’s leading powered stretchers. Designed, engineered, and built with safety and ease of use in mind, it excels in even the most challenging circumstances.
The PX2 stretcher provides exceptional stability in unpredictable environments, enabling operators to focus on delivering safe, effective patient care and transportation. With its innovative design, the Ferno PX2 elevates safety, performance, and maneuverability to new heights. Prioritizing control and reliability, this advanced stretcher empowers healthcare professionals to focus on what truly matters: patient well-being.
pages.title: Successful Order for More Than 400 Ambulance Stretchers | Ferno Norden

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Ergonomics and operator strain
In Nordic services, crews often work long shifts with high physical demands.
📌 Testing of control interfaces shows that improved button access and press angle can support more natural hand positioning during repeated use.
📌 Over time, this can support safer working conditions and more consistent operation across different crew members.
Ergonomics is not only about comfort, but about reducing strain and supporting stable workflows.
pages.title: What independent testing reveals for Power X2 | Ferno Norden

pages.main_text_excerpt:
How Power X2 and Power F2 support this shift
The Power X2 powered stretcher and the Power F2 fastening system illustrate how integrated patient transport is implemented in practice. Power X2 removes manual lifting during loading, unloading, and height adjustment, while Power F2 extends powered control into the vehicle.
Together, they create a continuous powered workflow that supports safer handling and more consistent operation from scene to transport. Cross-compatibility and phased implementation allow EMS services to modernise patient transport without disrupting daily operations.
pages.title: Why EMS is moving toward integrated patient transport solutions |…
